title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. translated_title: 表征未见之物：重新思考空间推理中的视觉想象
translated_abstract: 视觉世界模型通过生成未观测状态的RGB视图来支持空间推理。然而，RGB之所以成为默认接口，很大程度上是因为它适合视觉生成，而不一定是对下游推理最有效的表示形式。不同的空间问题可能受益于对同一想象状态的不同表示：俯视几何图有助于全局距离比较，而全景视图则为开放空间的推理提供更广阔的上下文。为了分离表示形式在空间想象中的作用，我们提出了ImagiRep，这是一个基于模拟器的基准，包含922个问题，涵盖两种设置（视角想象和跨视角整合）下的七种问题类型，并为同一未观测状态提供了真实RGB以及六种替代表示（如深度图、全景视图和俯视几何图）。这一受控比较揭示了……
tldr: 该论文提出基于模拟器的ImagiRep基准，在同一未观测状态下对比RGB与六种替代表示（深度、全景、俯视几何图等），揭示不同空间推理任务受益于不同的想象表示，从而重新审视了空间想象中RGB作为默认表示的合理性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark comparing oracle RGB with six alternative representations of the same unobserved state, revealing that different spatial reasoning questions benefit from different imagined representations rather than a default RGB interface.
